description: d_min=0.08 â€” production from month 50 onward flattens at 1600-1900 bbl/mo with very shallow decline, and out-of-sample R2=0.071 shows baseline over-declines in forecast. Raising d_min from 0.05 to 0.08 to capture terminal flattening.

outlier_threshold=0.20 â€” Jul 2021 zero month and sharp drops in Jan 2021 (3384) and Oct 2021 (2275) are anomalous vs surrounding months. Tighter outlier detection from 0.30 to 0.20 should remove these and improve the decline fit, especially for the forecast period.

qi_guess_strategy=max3 â€” early months have high variance (19018, 16544, 15688 bbl). Using max3 instead of first provides a more robust qi initial guess that may steer optimizer to a better local minimum and improve forecast.

smoothing_window=5 â€” production has sharp anomalies (zero month Jul 2021, drops to 3384/2275 in Jan/Oct 2021) that survive 3-month smoothing. Widening to 5 months should dampen these spikes and potentially shift the detected decline onset, changing the fit window.

b_upper_bound=1.0 â€” baseline fits b=1.22 (strongly hyperbolic) but out-of-sample R2=0.071 is poor. Capping b at 1.0 forces a less hyperbolic curve that may forecast the holdout period better by avoiding the flat-then-steep shape of high-b curves.

significance_threshold=0.30 â€” lowering from 0.50 to detect the steep early decline (19018 to 10150 in months 1-6) more sensitively. This may shift the decline onset and change the fitting window, giving the optimizer different data to work with.

significance_threshold=0.75 â€” raising from 0.50 to include more early production in the fit. Baseline uses 59 months; a more permissive threshold may extend this and give the optimizer more data to constrain the decline shape.

di_initial=0.90 â€” optimizer finds di=0.77 from di_initial=0.50. Starting from 0.90 approaches from the other side and may find a different local minimum that better captures the forecast period decline rate.

peak_merge_distance=7 â€” production shows multiple bumps after the initial peak (months 10-11 rebound to 9186/6730, then months 16-18 at 5300-5400). Widening merge distance from 3 to 7 could merge these into the initial peak, shifting the decline onset later and changing the fitting window.
